dispatches_vehicle_chk.name: dispatches_vehicle_chk
dispatches_vehicle_chk.value: "dispatches"."vehicle_no" IS NULL OR (length("dispatches"."vehicle_no") BETWEEN 4 AND 12 AND "dispatches"."vehicle_no" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z0-9]*')

dispatches_phone_chk.name: dispatches_phone_chk
dispatches_phone_chk.value: "dispatches"."driver_phone" IS NULL OR (length("dispatches"."driver_phone") = 10 AND "dispatches"."driver_phone" GLOB '[6-9]*' AND "dispatches"."driver_phone" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')

po_placed_chk.name: po_placed_chk
po_placed_chk.value: "purchase_orders"."status" = 'DRAFT' OR ("purchase_orders"."provider_id" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_orders"."qty_kg" IS NOT NULL)

po_total_chk.name: po_total_chk
po_total_chk.value: "purchase_orders"."total_paise" IS (CASE WHEN "purchase_orders"."rate_per_tonne_paise" IS NULL OR "purchase_orders"."qty_kg" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ("purchase_orders"."qty_kg" * "purchase_orders"."rate_per_tonne_paise" + 500) / 1000 END)
